name: Sony Alpha 7 III camera profile
description: A camera profile style for the Sony Alpha 7 III (ILCE-7M3), fitted at ISO 100 against the out-of-camera JPEG using the color look up table and tone curve modules. For a filmic workflow, apply the style, disable the tone curve and then use filmic.
